name: Alfred Powerpack
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For Alfred Powerpack, build a local launcher with search, snippets, clipboard history, and workflows. The hard boundary is years of macos integration, workflow ecosystem, reliability, and community, plus os integration polish and maintenance.
